popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Heracles' sack of Cos: the hero is driven off course and storms the island of Eurypylus — the Coan king named in the Catalogue tradition of Heracles' wanderings.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Makes Eurypylus son of Poseidon by Astypalaea; Heracles kills him when he takes Cos by night — distinct from Eurypylus son of Euaemon and from Telephus' Mysian son.

popCulture.title: Eurypylus of Cos
popCulture.description: King of Cos slain by Heracles — one of several Homeric Eurypyli.
